summary: AdaptHealth Corp. entered into an asset purchase agreement on July 19, 2026, to sell substantially all assets of its diabetes medical device and services business to RGH Enterprises, LLC, a Cardinal Health subsidiary, for $235 million in cash, subject to net working capital adjustment. The agreement includes customary representations, warranties, and post-closing covenants such as a four-year non-compete in North America. A portion of the purchase price will be held in escrow. The transaction is subject to customary closing conditions including regulatory approvals. Watch for antitrust clearance and completion timeline; risk-arb spread may indicate deal certainty.
